title: Penrose Tiling
comment: Penrose Tiling — Penrose tiling are aperiodic tilings obtained using typically 2 isosceles triangles with two type of edge labelings (so 4 types of triangles). A way to generate the tiling is by applying iterative edge splitting using the golden ratio. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Penrose_tiling

title: Line Int Conv

title: Frac Derivative
comment: Frac Derivative — The fractional Laplacian is a differential operator generalizing the Laplacian. They are the only rotation/translation/scale invariant linear operator. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fractional_Laplacian

title: Lin Nonlin Approx
comment: Lin Nonlin Approx — Linear approximation selects the first coefficients of a decomposition in an orthogonal basis. Non-linear selects the best coefficients. Non-linear approximation in a Wavelet basis is efficient to handle non-smooth functio… http://people.math.sc.edu/devore/publications/NLACTA.pdf

title: Varadhan Formula
comment: Varadhan Formula — Varadhan formula shows that at first order, the heat kernel is equal to the geodesic kernel. They are exactly equal on Euclidean spaces. http://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/cpa.3160200210/abstract
alt_text: Varadhan Formula. Varadhan formula shows that at first order, the heat kernel is equal to the geodesic kernel. They are exactly equal on Euclidean spaces.

title: Tutte Embedding

title: Tomography
comment: Tomography — Filtered back-propagation is a formula for the invert of the Radon transform, which can be approximated by using a finite of Radon projections. The basic method to reconstruct images in scanner imaging. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tomographic_reconstruction

title: Random Matrix
comment: Random Matrix — Eigenvalues of random matrices with iid entries converge to the Wigner circle law. This is universal (does not depend on the law of the entries), as proved by Tao and Vu in 2010. For Gaussian matrices, this defines a determinental point process. https://arxiv.org/abs/0908.1982
